inlines.v: WITCH-HAZEL, noun 1. A species of elm, (Ulmus montana.) 2. The hop-hornbeam, (carpinus ostrya.) The Virginian witch-hazel is the Hamemelis virginica, a shrub which flowers in autumn when its leaves are falling.
